+name: "PR video demo label"
+
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    types: [opened, edited, reopened, synchronize]
+
+cache-mode: none
+permissions:
+  pull-requests: write
+  issues: write
+
+jobs:
+  video-demo-label:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
+    steps:
+      - name: Add or remove the video demo label
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          PR_URL: ${{ github.event.pull_request.html_url }}
+          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+          # passed through env, so the body is only matched, never run, and is safe to read from a fork
+          BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
+          HAS_LABEL: ${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'video demo') }}
+        run: |
+          # sections written by demo:pr (see tools/ui/demo/cli.ts): the managed comment
+          # markers, or a preview linking to a demo video uploaded for this PR
+          has_demo=false
+          if { grep -qF '<!-- demo:start -->' <<< "$BODY" && grep -qF '<!-- demo:end -->' <<< "$BODY"; } ||
+            grep -qE "/resolve/videos/pr/$PR_NUMBER/[0-9a-f]{10}(-[0-9]+)?\.mp4" <<< "$BODY"; then
+            has_demo=true
+          fi
+
+          if [ "$has_demo" = true ] && [ "$HAS_LABEL" = false ]; then
+            gh pr edit "$PR_URL" --add-label 'video demo'
+          elif [ "$has_demo" = false ] && [ "$HAS_LABEL" = true ]; then
+            gh pr edit "$PR_URL" --remove-label 'video demo'
+          fi

+set(LLAMA_WIN_APP_MANIFEST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../common/win-app.manifest")
+
+if(WIN32)
+    if(MSVC OR CMAKE_CXX_SIMULATE_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
+        set(LLAMA_WIN_APP_MSVC_ABI TRUE)
+    else()
+        set(LLAMA_WIN_APP_MSVC_ABI FALSE)
+    endif()
+
+    if(NOT LLAMA_WIN_APP_MSVC_ABI)
+        if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.21)
+            message(FATAL_ERROR "CMake 3.21 or newer is required to build for Windows with the GNU ABI")
+        endif()
+        enable_language(RC)
+        set(LLAMA_WIN_APP_MANIFEST_RC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/win-app-manifest.rc")
+        file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${LLAMA_WIN_APP_MANIFEST_RC}" CONTENT "1 24 \"@LLAMA_WIN_APP_MANIFEST@\"\n" @ONLY)
+        set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${LLAMA_WIN_APP_MANIFEST}")
+    endif()
+endif()
+
+function(llama_add_app_manifest target)
+    if(NOT WIN32)
+        return()
+    endif()
+    get_target_property(_aliased ${target} ALIASED_TARGET)
+    if(_aliased)
+        return()
+    endif()
+    get_target_property(_type ${target} TYPE)
+    if(NOT _type STREQUAL "EXECUTABLE")
+        return()
+    endif()
+    if(LLAMA_WIN_APP_MSVC_ABI)
+        target_sources(${target} PRIVATE "${LLAMA_WIN_APP_MANIFEST}")
+    else()
+        if(NOT TARGET llama-win-app-manifest-res)

+# Chatterbox (ResembleAI) turbo and multilingual v3, from the raw checkpoints of the official repos
+# the checkpoints ship no config.json, the variant is detected from the talker file and the hparams come from the reference code
+# talker: text_emb and speech_emb are fused into one [text | speech] vocab, speech token i is <|speech_i|>
+# mmproj: the s3gen sidecar, the voice and conditioning encoders, the position and speech tables, and the conds.pt voice
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Callable, Iterable
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from torch import Tensor
+
+from .base import ModelBase, TextModel, MmprojModel, LazyTorchTensor, gguf, logger
+from .llama import LlamaModel
+
+# checkpoint file prefixes, the files are "<prefix>.safetensors"
+TURBO_TALKER = "t3_turbo_v1"
+MTL_TALKER   = "t3_mtl23ls_v3"
+TURBO_S3GEN  = "s3gen_meanflow"
+MTL_S3GEN    = "s3gen_v3"
+VE           = "ve"
+
+# relative speech ids shared by both variants (start/stop_speech_token in the reference)
+SPEECH_BOS = 6561
+SPEECH_EOS = 6562
+
+# sampling defaults of the reference, samplers it does not use are disabled so the common defaults do not apply
+TURBO_TOP_K = 1000
+MTL_TOP_K   = 0
+TURBO_SAMPLING = {"min_p": 0.0,  "top_p": 0.95, "temp": 0.8, "penalty_repeat": 1.2}
+MTL_SAMPLING   = {"min_p": 0.05, "top_p": 1.0,  "temp": 0.8, "penalty_repeat": 1.2}
+# the reference repetition penalty covers the whole generated history
+PENALTY_LAST_N = -1
+
+
+def _has_file(dir_model: Path, prefix: str) -> bool:
+    return (dir_model / f"{prefix}.safetensors").is_file()
+
+
+def _is_turbo(dir_model: Path) -> bool:
+    if _has_file(dir_model, TURBO_TALKER):
+        return True
+    if _has_file(dir_model, MTL_TALKER):
+        return False
+    raise FileNotFoundError(f"no chatterbox talker checkpoint in {dir_model}")
+
+
+# talker hparams of the reference (GPT2_MEDIUM_CONFIG / LLAMA_520M_CONFIG_DICT, T3Config)
+TURBO_TEXT_CONFIG = {
+    "n_layer": 24, "n_embd": 1024, "n_inner": 4096, "n_head": 16, "n_ctx": 8196, "layer_norm_epsilon": 1e-05,
+    "vocab_size": 50276, "speech_vocab_size": 6563,
+}
+MTL_TEXT_CONFIG = {
+    "num_hidden_layers": 30, "hidden_size": 1024, "intermediate_size": 4096, "num_attention_heads": 16,
+    "num_key_value_heads": 16, "head_dim": 64, "max_position_embeddings": 131072, "rms_norm_eps": 1e-05,
+    "rope_theta": 500000.0,
+    "rope_scaling": {"factor": 8.0, "high_freq_factor": 4.0, "low_freq_factor": 1.0, "original_max_position_embeddings": 8192},
+    "vocab_size": 2454, "speech_vocab_size": 8194,
+}
+
+
+def _is_chatterbox_checkpoint(dir_model: Path) -> bool:
+    return _has_file(dir_model, VE) and (_has_file(dir_model, TURBO_TALKER) or _has_file(dir_model, MTL_TALKER))
+
+
+@ModelBase.register_hparams_loader(_is_chatterbox_checkpoint)
+def _load_chatterbox_hparams(dir_model: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    turbo = _is_turbo(dir_model)
+    logger.info(f"gguf: detected Chatterbox {'turbo' if turbo else 'multilingual v3'} checkpoint")
+    text_config = dict(TURBO_TEXT_CONFIG if turbo else MTL_TEXT_CONFIG)
+    # the mmproj tensors are named explicitly, they do not go through the block tensor map
+    return {"architectures": ["ChatterboxModel"], "text_config": text_config, "audio_config": {"num_hidden_layers": 0}}
+
+
+@ModelBase.register("ChatterboxModel")
+class ChatterboxTalkerModel(TextModel):
+    model_arch = gguf.MODEL_ARCH.LLAMA  # multilingual; the turbo constructor switches to GPT2
+
+    def __init__(self, dir_model: Path, *args, **kwargs):
+        self.is_turbo = _is_turbo(dir_model)
+        if self.is_turbo:
+            self.model_arch = gguf.MODEL_ARCH.GPT2
+        super().__init__(dir_model, *args, **kwargs)
+        self._text_embd: Tensor | None = None
+        self._speech_embd: Tensor | None = None
+        self._text_head: Tensor | None = None
+        self._speech_head: Tensor | None = None
+
+    def index_tensors(self, remote_hf_model_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Callable[[], Tensor]]:
+        return self.index_local_tensors(TURBO_TALKER if self.is_turbo else MTL_TALKER)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def filter_tensors(cls, item: tuple[str, Callable[[], Tensor]]) -> tuple[str, Callable[[], Tensor]] | None:
+        name, _ = item
+        # the reference feeds inputs_embeds, the transformer input embeddings are unused
+        if name in ("tfmr.wte.weight", "tfmr.embed_tokens.weight"):
+            return None
+        if name.startswith(("cond_enc.", "text_pos_emb.", "speech_pos_emb.")):
+            return None
+        return super().filter_tensors(item)
+
+    def set_vocab(self):
+        if self.is_turbo:
+            self._set_vocab_turbo()
+        else:
+            self._set_vocab_mtl()
+
+    def _speech_token_names(self, n_speech: int) -> list[str]:
+        return [f"<|speech_{i}|>" for i in range(n_speech)]
+
+    def _set_vocab_turbo(self):
+        # stock GPT-2 BPE from the checkpoint dir, extended with the speech tokens
+        tokens, toktypes, tokpre = self.get_vocab_base()
+        n_text = len(tokens)
+        n_speech = self.hparams["speech_vocab_size"]
+        speech = self._speech_token_names(n_speech)
+        tokens += speech
+        toktypes += [gguf.TokenType.CONTROL] * n_speech
+
+        with open(self.dir_model / "merges.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            merges = [line.rstrip("\n") for line in f if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#version")]
+
+        self._write_vocab(tokens, toktypes, merges, tokpre, n_text)
+
+    def _write_vocab(self, tokens: list[str], toktypes: list[int], merges: list[str], tokpre: str, n_text: int):
+        self.gguf_writer.add_tokenizer_model("gpt2")
+        self.gguf_writer.add_tokenizer_pre(tokpre)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_token_list(tokens)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_token_types(toktypes)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_token_merges(merges)
+
+        self.gguf_writer.add_bos_token_id(n_text + SPEECH_BOS)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_eos_token_id(n_text + SPEECH_EOS)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_add_bos_token(False)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_add_eos_token(False)
+
+        # the reference samples the speech head only
+        self.gguf_writer.add_suppress_tokens(list(range(n_text)))
+
+    def _set_vocab_mtl(self):
+        # the reference BPE is char-level, it is re-encoded to byte-level with extra merges that rebuild each multi-byte char
+        # its lowercasing is folded into the embedding table, so the prompt needs no text preprocessing
+        with open(self.dir_model / "mtl_tokenizer.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            tok = json.load(f)
+
+        byte_map = gguf.vocab.bytes_to_unicode()
+
+        def enc(s: str) -> str:
+            return "".join(byte_map[b] for b in s.encode("utf-8"))
+
+        n_text = self.hparams["vocab_size"]
+        tokens: list[str] = [f"[unused_{i}]" for i in range(n_text)]
+        toktypes = [int(gguf.TokenType.UNUSED)] * n_text
+        char_merges: list[str] = []
+        for t, i in tok["model"]["vocab"].items():
+            if t == " ":
+                # the reference substitutes [SPACE] before encoding, the raw space token is never used
+                continue
+            tokens[i] = enc(t)
+            toktypes[i] = int(gguf.TokenType.NORMAL)
+            if len(t) == 1 and len(t.encode("utf-8")) > 1:
+                parts = [byte_map[b] for b in t.encode("utf-8")]
+                for k in range(1, len(parts)):
+                    char_merges.append("".join(parts[:k]) + " " + parts[k])
+        for entry in tok.get("added_tokens", []):
+            tokens[entry["id"]] = entry["content"]
+            toktypes[entry["id"]] = int(gguf.TokenType.CONTROL)
+
+        # raw spaces tokenize to [SPACE] directly
+        space_id = tok["model"]["vocab"]["[SPACE]"]
+        tokens[space_id] = enc(" ")
+        toktypes[space_id] = int(gguf.TokenType.NORMAL)
+
+        n_speech = self.hparams["speech_vocab_size"]
+        tokens += self._speech_token_names(n_speech)
+        toktypes += [int(gguf.TokenType.CONTROL)] * n_speech
+
+        # chars are atomic in the reference, they must form before any of its merges
+        merges = char_merges
+        for m in tok["model"].get("merges", []):
+            a, b = m if isinstance(m, list) else m.split(" ")
+            merges.append(enc(a) + " " + enc(b))
+
+        self._write_vocab(tokens, toktypes, merges, "default", n_text)
+
+    def _mtl_case_fold_pairs(self) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
+        # (upper_id, lower_id) of the single-char vocab entries, for every script in the vocab
+        with open(self.dir_model / "mtl_tokenizer.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            vocab = json.load(f)["model"]["vocab"]
+        pairs: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
+        for t, i in vocab.items():
+            if len(t) != 1:
+                continue
+            low = t.lower()
+            if low != t and len(low) == 1 and low in vocab:
+                pairs.append((i, vocab[low]))
+        return pairs
+
+    def set_gguf_parameters(self):
+        super().set_gguf_parameters()
+
+        sampling = TURBO_SAMPLING if self.is_turbo else MTL_SAMPLING
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sampling_top_k(TURBO_TOP_K if self.is_turbo else MTL_TOP_K)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sampling_min_p(sampling["min_p"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sampling_top_p(sampling["top_p"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sampling_temp(sampling["temp"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sampling_penalty_repeat(sampling["penalty_repeat"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sampling_penalty_last_n(PENALTY_LAST_N)
+        if not self.is_turbo:
+            self.gguf_writer.add_classifier_free_guidance(True)
+
+    def generate_extra_tensors(self) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        if self.is_turbo:
+            return
+        # llama3 rope scaling baked into the rope_freqs factors tensor
+        rp = self.hparams["rope_scaling"]
+        dim = self.hparams["head_dim"]
+        base = self.hparams["rope_theta"]
+        freqs = 1.0 / (base ** (torch.arange(0, dim, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / dim))
+        factor = rp["factor"]
+        low_freq_wavelen = rp["original_max_position_embeddings"] / rp["low_freq_factor"]
+        high_freq_wavelen = rp["original_max_position_embeddings"] / rp["high_freq_factor"]
+        rope_factors = []
+        for freq in freqs:
+            wavelen = 2 * math.pi / freq
+            if wavelen < high_freq_wavelen:
+                rope_factors.append(1)
+            elif wavelen > low_freq_wavelen:
+                rope_factors.append(factor)
+            else:
+                smooth = (rp["original_max_position_embeddings"] / wavelen - rp["low_freq_factor"]) / (rp["high_freq_factor"] - rp["low_freq_factor"])
+                rope_factors.append(1 / ((1 - smooth) / factor + smooth))
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.ROPE_FREQS), torch.tensor(rope_factors, dtype=torch.float32))
+
+    def _maybe_emit_fused(self) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        if self._text_embd is not None and self._speech_embd is not None:
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.TOKEN_EMBD),
+                   torch.cat([self._text_embd, self._speech_embd], dim=0))
+            self._text_embd = None
+            self._speech_embd = None
+        if self._text_head is not None and self._speech_head is not None:
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.OUTPUT),
+                   torch.cat([self._text_head, self._speech_head], dim=0))
+            self._text_head = None
+            self._speech_head = None
+
+    def modify_tensors(self, data_torch: Tensor, name: str, bid: int | None) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        # generate_extra_tensors output comes back through here with its final name
+        if name.startswith("rope_freqs"):
+            yield (name, data_torch)
+            return
+        # fused [text | speech] vocab: embeddings and output head
+        if name == "text_emb.weight":
+            if not self.is_turbo:
+                # the reference lowercases its input, the uppercase rows take the lowercase ones
+                fold = list(range(data_torch.shape[0]))
+                for upper, lower in self._mtl_case_fold_pairs():
+                    fold[upper] = lower
+                data_torch = data_torch[torch.tensor(fold)]
+            self._text_embd = data_torch
+            yield from self._maybe_emit_fused()
+            return
+        if name == "speech_emb.weight":
+            self._speech_embd = data_torch
+            yield from self._maybe_emit_fused()
+            return
+        if name == "text_head.weight":
+            self._text_head = data_torch
+            yield from self._maybe_emit_fused()
+            return
+        if name == "speech_head.weight":
+            self._speech_head = data_torch
+            yield from self._maybe_emit_fused()
+            return
+        if name == "speech_head.bias":
+            # the text head has no bias, its zone is suppressed at sampling anyway
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.OUTPUT, suffix=".bias"), F.pad(data_torch, (self.hparams["vocab_size"], 0)))
+            return
+
+        assert name.startswith("tfmr.")
+        name = name[len("tfmr."):]
+
+        if self.is_turbo:
+            # HF GPT-2 layout: Conv1D style weights are stored transposed
+            if name.endswith((".c_attn.weight", ".c_proj.weight", ".c_fc.weight")):

+    @classmethod
+    def filter_tensors(cls, item: tuple[str, Callable[[], Tensor]]) -> tuple[str, Callable[[], Tensor]] | None:
+        # the s3gen, ve and talker checkpoints have disjoint top-level names
+        name, gen = item
+        new_name: str | None = None
+        # batchnorm bookkeeping (over the gguf name length cap) and the tokenizer dsp buffers are unused
+        if name.endswith("num_batches_tracked") or name in ("tokenizer.window", "tokenizer._mel_filters"):
+            return None

+    def _fuse_weight_norm(self, name: str, data_torch: Tensor) -> tuple[str, Tensor] | None:
+        # torch weight_norm parametrization: weight = g * v / |v| over dims 1..n
+        base = name.split(".parametrizations.weight.original")[0]
+        if name.endswith("original0"):
+            self._wnorm_g[base] = data_torch
+        else:
+            self._wnorm_v[base] = data_torch
+        if base in self._wnorm_g and base in self._wnorm_v:
+            g = self._wnorm_g.pop(base)
+            v = self._wnorm_v.pop(base)
+            norm = v.float().norm(dim=tuple(range(1, v.dim())), keepdim=True)
+            return (base + ".weight", g.float() * v.float() / norm)
+        return None

+    def modify_tensors(self, data_torch: Tensor, name: str, bid: int | None) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        if ".parametrizations.weight.original" in name:
+            fused = self._fuse_weight_norm(name, data_torch)
+            if fused is not None:

+            return

+        del name, bid

+        if new_name.startswith(("a.ve.", "a.cenc.", "voice.", "a.gen.t3.", "a.gen.hift.m_source.")):
+            return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F32
+        # the conv ops have no BF16 kernels
+        if n_dims >= 2 and new_name.endswith((".weight", ".weight_v")):
+            return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F16
+        return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F32

+    def generate_extra_tensors(self) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        conds = torch.load(self.dir_model / "conds.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+        t3c = conds["t3"] if isinstance(conds, dict) else conds.t3
+        genc = conds["gen"] if isinstance(conds, dict) else conds.gen
+        t3c = vars(t3c) if not isinstance(t3c, dict) else t3c
+        genc = vars(genc) if not isinstance(genc, dict) else genc
+
+        def talker_tensor(name: str) -> Tensor:
+            return LazyTorchTensor.to_eager(self.model_tensors[name]())
+
+        # the conds.pt voice: voice.default holds the talker conditioning rows, voice.default.ref_* the flow decoder reference
+        # 1D tensors are written as F32, the speech ids stay exact
+        yield ("voice.default.ref_tokens", genc["prompt_token"][0].float())
+        yield ("voice.default.ref_feat", genc["prompt_feat"][0].float())
+        yield ("voice.default.ref_spk", genc["embedding"][0].float())
+
+        spkr_w = talker_tensor("a.cenc.spkr_enc.weight").float()
+        spkr_b = talker_tensor("a.cenc.spkr_enc.bias").float()
+        spkr_row = spkr_w @ t3c["speaker_emb"][0].float() + spkr_b
+        speech_emb = talker_tensor(self.format_tensor_name(gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.A_GEN_CODE_OUT_EMBD)).float()
+        cond_tokens = t3c["cond_prompt_speech_tokens"][0]
+
+        if self.is_turbo:
+            # turbo talker conditioning: [spkr, speech rows of the cond tokens]
+            yield ("voice.default", torch.cat([spkr_row[None], speech_emb[cond_tokens]], dim=0))
+            return
+
+        # multilingual talker conditioning [spkr, perceiver x32, emotion], from the reference perceiver over the cond speech tokens
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            speech_pos = talker_tensor("a.gen.t3.speech_pos_emb").float()
+            pse = speech_emb[cond_tokens] + speech_pos[: cond_tokens.shape[0]]
+
+            ln_w = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.norm.weight").float()
+            ln_b = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.norm.bias").float()
+            wq = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.to_q.weight").float()
+            bq = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.to_q.bias").float()
+            wk = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.to_k.weight").float()
+            bk = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.to_k.bias").float()
+            wv = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.to_v.weight").float()
+            bv = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.to_v.bias").float()
+            wo = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.proj_out.weight").float()
+            bo = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.attn.proj_out.bias").float()
+            query = talker_tensor("a.cenc.perceiver.pre_attention_query")[0].float()
+
+            n_head = 4
+            n_e = query.shape[1]
+
+            def attn_block(x1: Tensor, x2: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+                nx1 = F.layer_norm(x1, (n_e,), ln_w, ln_b)
+                nx2 = F.layer_norm(x2, (n_e,), ln_w, ln_b)
+                q = (nx1 @ wq.T + bq).view(-1, n_head, n_e // n_head).transpose(0, 1)
+                k = (nx2 @ wk.T + bk).view(-1, n_head, n_e // n_head).transpose(0, 1)
+                v = (nx2 @ wv.T + bv).view(-1, n_head, n_e // n_head).transpose(0, 1)
+                ctx = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
+                ctx = ctx.transpose(0, 1).reshape(-1, n_e)
+                return ctx @ wo.T + bo + x1
+
+            pre = attn_block(query, pse)
+            p32 = attn_block(pre, pre)
+
+            emo = talker_tensor("a.cenc.emotion_adv_fc.weight").float()
+            emo_row = emo[:, 0] * t3c["emotion_adv"].reshape(-1)[0]
+            yield ("voice.default", torch.cat([spkr_row[None], p32, emo_row[None]], dim=0))

+from __future__ import annotations

+# Engram hash constants from inference/engram.py, stored in the GGUF: the token map needs the HF tokenizers
+# normalizers and the multipliers numpy's PCG64 stream, neither of which the runtime has.
+
+def _is_prime(n: int) -> bool:
+    if n < 2 or n % 2 == 0:
+        return n == 2
+    return all(n % d for d in range(3, math.isqrt(n) + 1, 2))
+
+
+def engram_primes(n_layers: int, max_ngram_size: int, n_heads: int, vocab_size: int) -> list[list[list[int]]]:
+    """EngramLayout.from_args: [layer][ngram order 2..max][head] bucket moduli, never reused across layers."""
+    seen: set[int] = set()
+    out: list[list[list[int]]] = []
+    for _ in range(n_layers):
+        per_ngram = []
+        for _ in range(max_ngram_size - 1):
+            sizes, cur = [], vocab_size - 1
+            for _ in range(n_heads):
+                cand = cur + 1
+                while not _is_prime(cand) or cand in seen:
+                    cand += 1
+                cur = cand
+                seen.add(cur)
+                sizes.append(cur)
+            per_ngram.append(sizes)
+        out.append(per_ngram)
+    return out
+
+
+def engram_multipliers(layer_ids: list[int], max_ngram_size: int, compressed_vocab_size: int) -> list[list[int]]:
+    """compute_hash_multipliers: odd, bounded so that token_id * multiplier cannot overflow int64."""
+    bound = max(1, (np.iinfo(np.int64).max // compressed_vocab_size) // 2)
+    rows = []
+    for layer_id in layer_ids:
+        rng = np.random.default_rng(10007 * layer_id)
+        values = rng.integers(low=0, high=bound, size=(max_ngram_size,), dtype=np.int64)
+        rows.append([int(v) * 2 + 1 for v in values])
+    return rows
+
+
+def engram_compressed_token_map(tokenizer_dir: Path) -> tuple[list[int], int]:
+    """build_compressed_token_map: token id -> compressed id (tokens that normalize alike collapse)."""
+    from tokenizers import Regex, normalizers
+    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(tokenizer_dir)
+    sentinel = "\ue000"
+    normalizer = normalizers.Sequence([
+        normalizers.NFKC(),
+        normalizers.NFD(),
+        normalizers.StripAccents(),
+        normalizers.Lowercase(),
+        normalizers.Replace(Regex(r"[ \t\r\n]+"), " "),
+        normalizers.Replace(Regex(r"^ $"), sentinel),
+        normalizers.Strip(),
+        normalizers.Replace(sentinel, " "),
+    ])
+    backend = tokenizer.backend_tokenizer
+    key_to_new: dict[str, int] = {}
+    lookup = [0] * len(tokenizer)
+    for token_id in range(len(tokenizer)):
+        text = backend.decode([token_id], skip_special_tokens=False)
+        if "\ufffd" in text:
+            key = backend.id_to_token(token_id)
+        else:
+            normalized = normalizer.normalize_str(text)
+            key = normalized if normalized else text
+        lookup[token_id] = key_to_new.setdefault(key, len(key_to_new))
+    return lookup, len(key_to_new)

+class _StreamedBytes:
+    """Raw tensor bytes produced chunk by chunk at write time (an Engram table is ~200 GB in BF16)."""
+    def __init__(self, shape: tuple[int, ...], chunks: Callable[[], Iterable[np.ndarray]]):
+        self.shape = shape
+        self.dtype = np.dtype(np.uint8)
+        self.nbytes = int(np.prod(shape))
+        self._chunks = chunks
+
+    def tofile(self, fout) -> None:
+        written = 0
+        for chunk in self._chunks():
+            chunk = np.ascontiguousarray(chunk, dtype=np.uint8)
+            chunk.tofile(fout)
+            written += chunk.nbytes
+        if written != self.nbytes:
+            raise ValueError(f"streamed {written} bytes, expected {self.nbytes}")
+
+    def byteswap(self, inplace: bool = False):
+        raise NotImplementedError("streamed tensors are written little-endian only")
+
+
+def _e8m0_check(scale_u8: np.ndarray, name: str) -> None:
+    # e4m3 (|x| in [2^-9, 448]) * 2^(e - 127) is exact in BF16 for e in [3, 246]
+    if scale_u8.size and (int(scale_u8.min()) < 3 or int(scale_u8.max()) > 246):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: E8M0 scale exponents outside [3, 246], the dequantized values would not be exact")
+

+    (--dspark, DeepseekV41DSparkModel); the vision tower goes to an mmproj (--mmproj, DeepseekV41VisionModel).

+            for li, layer_primes in enumerate(primes):

+    def filter_tensors(cls, item: tuple[str, Callable[[], Tensor]]) -> tuple[str, Callable[[], Tensor]] | None:
+        name = item[0]
+        if name.startswith("audio_decoder") or name == "model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight":
+            return item
+        return None
+
+    def tensor_force_quant(self, name, new_name, bid, n_dims):
+        # conv1d/conv1d_dw kernels must be F16, ggml_conv_1d(_dw) has no BF16 path
+        if new_name.endswith(".weight") and (
+            new_name in ("a.gen.wav.dac.entry.weight", "a.gen.wav.dac.post_conv.weight")
+            or (".up.blk." in new_name and new_name.endswith(".dwconv.weight"))
+            or (".dac.blk." in new_name and (new_name.endswith(".conv1.weight") or new_name.endswith(".conv2.weight")))
+        ):
+            return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F16
+        # keep ConvTranspose1d kernels and folded codebook tables in F32
+        if new_name.endswith(".conv.weight") and (".up.blk." in new_name or ".dac.blk." in new_name):
+            return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F32
+        if new_name.startswith("a.gen.wav.quant."):
+            return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F32
+        return super().tensor_force_quant(name, new_name, bid, n_dims)
+
+    def modify_tensors(self, data_torch: Tensor, name: str, bid: int | None) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        T = gguf.MODEL_TENSOR
+        cfg = self.hparams
+
+        if name.startswith("a.gen.wav."):
+            yield (name, data_torch)
+            return
+
+        if name == "model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight":
+            # semantic band of the backbone embeddings
+            begin = self.global_config["semantic_start_token_id"]
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_OUT_EMBD), data_torch[begin:begin + cfg["vocab_size"]])
+            return
+
+        if name == "audio_decoder.codebook_embeddings.weight":
+            n_cb = cfg["num_codebooks"]
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_EMBD), data_torch.reshape(n_cb, -1, data_torch.shape[-1]))
+            return
+
+        if name.startswith("audio_decoder_mtp.heads."):
+            n_heads = cfg["num_codebooks"] - 1
+            self._heads[int(name.split(".")[2])] = data_torch
+            if len(self._heads) < n_heads:
+                return
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_HEAD), torch.stack([self._heads.pop(i) for i in range(n_heads)]))
+            return
+
+        for prefix, offset in ((_TOWER_SHARED, 0), (_TOWER_RESIDUAL, cfg["shared_enrichment_layers"])):
+            if not name.startswith(prefix):
+                continue
+            idx, key = name[len(prefix):].split(".", 1)
+            il = int(idx) + offset
+            if key == "transformer_layer.attention.wqkv.weight":
+                # rows are [query | gate | key | value]
+                n_q = cfg["n_head"] * cfg["head_dim"]
+                n_kv = cfg["n_local_heads"] * cfg["head_dim"]
+                q, gate, k, v = data_torch.split([n_q, n_q, n_kv, n_kv], dim=0)
+                yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_ATTN_Q, il), q)
+                yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_ATTN_GATE, il), gate)
+                yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_ATTN_K, il), k)
+                yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_ATTN_V, il), v)
+                return
+            tensor, zero_centered = self._LAYER_MAP[key]
+            if zero_centered:
+                data_torch = data_torch.float() + 1
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(tensor, il), data_torch)
+            return
+
+        raise ValueError(f"unexpected tensor {name}")
+
+    def generate_extra_tensors(self) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        # only the DAC decoder, the encoder is for voice cloning (not supported yet)
+        sd = torch.load(self.dir_model / "codec.pth", map_location="cpu", mmap=True, weights_only=True)
+        sd = sd.get("state_dict", sd)
+        T = gguf.MODEL_TENSOR
+
+        def get(name: str) -> Tensor:
+            return sd[name].float()
+
+        def conv(prefix: str) -> Tensor:
+            # fold weight norm
+            if prefix + ".conv.weight" in sd:
+                return get(prefix + ".conv.weight")
+            g = get(prefix + ".conv.parametrizations.weight.original0")
+            v = get(prefix + ".conv.parametrizations.weight.original1")
+            return g * v / v.norm(dim=(1, 2), keepdim=True)
+
+        def quant_table(prefix: str) -> Tensor:
+            # fold out_proj into the codebook, so decoding is a row lookup
+            g = get(prefix + ".out_proj.weight_g")
+            v = get(prefix + ".out_proj.weight_v")
+            w = (g * v / v.norm(dim=(1, 2), keepdim=True)).squeeze(-1)
+            return get(prefix + ".codebook.weight") @ w.T + get(prefix + ".out_proj.bias")
+
+        def snake(alpha: Tensor) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
+            alpha = alpha.flatten()
+            return alpha, 1.0 / (alpha + 1e-9)
+
+        q = "quantizer."
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_QUANT_FIRST_CB), quant_table(q + "semantic_quantizer.quantizers.0"))
+        n_rest = sum(1 for k in sd if k.startswith(q + "quantizer.quantizers.") and k.endswith(".codebook.weight"))
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_QUANT_REST_CB),
+               torch.stack([quant_table(f"{q}quantizer.quantizers.{i}") for i in range(n_rest)]))
+
+        # post_module uses interleaved RoPE, permute q/k rows so NEOX RoPE gives the same result
+        tfm = q + "post_module."
+        n_head, d_head = 16, 64
+        order = torch.cat([torch.arange(0, d_head, 2), torch.arange(1, d_head, 2)])
+
+        def neox_rows(w: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+            return w.reshape(n_head, d_head, -1)[:, order].reshape(w.shape)
+
+        n_tfm = sum(1 for k in sd if k.startswith(tfm + "layers.") and k.endswith(".ffn_norm.weight"))
+        for il in range(n_tfm):
+            p = f"{tfm}layers.{il}."
+            wq, wk, wv = get(p + "attention.wqkv.weight").chunk(3, dim=0)
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_ATTN_Q, il), neox_rows(wq))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_ATTN_K, il), neox_rows(wk))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_ATTN_V, il), wv)
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_ATTN_OUT, il), get(p + "attention.wo.weight"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_ATTN_NORM, il), get(p + "attention_norm.weight"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_ATTN_SCALE, il), get(p + "attention_layer_scale.gamma"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_FFN_NORM, il), get(p + "ffn_norm.weight"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_FFN_GATE, il), get(p + "feed_forward.w1.weight"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_FFN_UP, il), get(p + "feed_forward.w3.weight"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_FFN_DOWN, il), get(p + "feed_forward.w2.weight"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_FFN_SCALE, il), get(p + "ffn_layer_scale.gamma"))
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_OUTPUT_NORM), get(tfm + "norm.weight"))
+
+        # upsample: 2x (ConvTranspose1d + ConvNeXt)
+        for il in range(2):
+            p = f"{q}upsample.{il}."
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_CONV, il, suffix=".weight"), conv(p + "0"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_CONV, il, suffix=".bias"), get(p + "0.conv.bias"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_DWCONV, il, suffix=".weight"), conv(p + "1.dwconv"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_DWCONV, il, suffix=".bias"), get(p + "1.dwconv.conv.bias"))
+            for key, tensor in (("norm", T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_NORM), ("pwconv1", T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_PW1), ("pwconv2", T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_PW2)):
+                yield (self.format_tensor_name(tensor, il, suffix=".weight"), get(f"{p}1.{key}.weight"))
+                yield (self.format_tensor_name(tensor, il, suffix=".bias"), get(f"{p}1.{key}.bias"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_GAMMA, il, suffix=""), get(p + "1.gamma"))
+
+        # DAC: entry conv, 4x (Snake, ConvTranspose1d, 3 residual units), Snake, post conv
+        d = "decoder.model."
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_ENTRY, suffix=".weight"), conv(d + "0"))
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_ENTRY, suffix=".bias"), get(d + "0.conv.bias"))
+        for bid in range(4):
+            p = f"{d}{bid + 1}.block."
+            a, b = snake(get(p + "0.alpha"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_UP_SNAKE, bid, suffix=".alpha"), a)
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_UP_SNAKE, bid, suffix=".beta"), b)
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_UP_CONV, bid, suffix=".weight"), conv(p + "1"))
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_UP_CONV, bid, suffix=".bias"), get(p + "1.conv.bias"))
+            for xid in range(3):
+                r = f"{p}{xid + 2}.block."
+                for act, tensor in (("0", T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_RES_ACT1), ("2", T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_RES_ACT2)):
+                    a, b = snake(get(r + act + ".alpha"))
+                    name = gguf.TENSOR_NAMES[tensor].format(bid=bid, xid=xid)
+                    yield (name + ".alpha", a)
+                    yield (name + ".beta", b)
+                for cv, tensor in (("1", T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_RES_CONV1), ("3", T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_RES_CONV2)):
+                    name = gguf.TENSOR_NAMES[tensor].format(bid=bid, xid=xid)
+                    yield (name + ".weight", conv(r + cv))
+                    yield (name + ".bias", get(r + cv + ".conv.bias"))
+        a, b = snake(get(d + "5.alpha"))
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_POST_SNAKE, suffix=".alpha"), a)
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_POST_SNAKE, suffix=".beta"), b)
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_POST_CONV, suffix=".weight"), conv(d + "6"))
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_DAC_POST_CONV, suffix=".bias"), get(d + "6.conv.bias"))

+def _is_h2o_lightning_checkpoint(dir_model: Path) -> bool:
+    return (dir_model / "h2o_lightning_shim.py").is_file() and (dir_model / "serve_config.json").is_file()
+
+
+@ModelBase.register_hparams_loader(_is_h2o_lightning_checkpoint)
+def _load_h2o_lightning_hparams(dir_model: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    logger.info("gguf: detected H2O-Lightning checkpoint")
+    hparams = ModelBase.load_hparams(dir_model, False, guess=False)
+    hparams["architectures"] = ["H2OLightningModel"]
+    return hparams
+
+
+@ModelBase.register("H2OLightningModel")
+@ModelBase.example("h2oai/h2o-lightning-4b")
+class H2OLightningModel(Qwen3_5TextModel):
+    model_arch = gguf.MODEL_ARCH.QWEN35
+
+    # prompt and calibration follow serve_config.json and h2o_lightning_shim.py of the model repo
+    # the state budget is hard-coded in server-decision.cpp
+    _MAX_STATE_TOKENS = 32000
+    _DEFAULT_INSTRUCTIONS = "Answer the question below."
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        with open(self.dir_model / "serve_config.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            self._serve_config = json.load(f)
+        prompt = self._serve_config["prompt"]
+        expected = {
+            "state_compact":    (prompt.get("state_compact", True), True),
+            "max_state_tokens": (prompt.get("max_state_tokens"), self._MAX_STATE_TOKENS),
+            "layout":           (prompt.get("layout", "plain"), "plain"),
+            "chat_template":    (prompt.get("chat_template", True), True),
+            "enable_thinking":  (prompt.get("enable_thinking", False), False),
+        }
+        for name, (got, want) in expected.items():
+            if got != want:
+                raise ValueError(f"serve_config.json: {name} is {got!r}, the h2o-lightning decision type expects {want!r}")
+
+    def get_vocab_base_pre(self, tokenizer) -> str:
+        # transformers loads this checkpoint as Qwen2Tokenizer: the model was trained and is served with the Qwen2 split
+        pre = super().get_vocab_base_pre(tokenizer)
+        if pre != "qwen35":
+            raise ValueError(f"expected the Qwen3.5 tokenizer, got pre-tokenizer {pre!r}")
+        return "qwen2"
+
+    def set_vocab(self):
+        super().set_vocab()
+        self.gguf_writer.add_chat_template([{"name": "systemone", "template": self._systemone_template()}])
+
+    def _systemone_template(self) -> str:
+        # the server gives the template texts rendered as the shim renders them, it only lays them out
+        prompt = self._serve_config["prompt"]
+        nl = "{{ '\\n' }}"
+        description = (
+            "{% if type == 'noul' %}"
+            "{% if o.description %}{{ o.description }}{% elif o.key == 'true' %}the statement holds{% else %}it does not{% endif %}"
+            "{% elif o.description is none %}{{ o.key }}{% else %}{{ o.description }}{% endif %}"
+        )
+        user = (
+            "{% set user %}record: {{ state }}" + nl
+            + "question: {{ instructions if instructions else '" + self._DEFAULT_INSTRUCTIONS + "' }}" + nl
+            + "options:{% for o in options %}" + nl + "{{ o.label | trim }}) {{ o.key }}: " + description + "{% endfor %}{% endset %}"
+        )
+        return (
+            "<|im_start|>system" + nl + prompt["system"].strip() + "<|im_end|>" + nl
+            + "<|im_start|>user" + nl + "{% for image in images %}{{ image }}{% endfor %}" + user + "{{ user | trim }}<|im_end|>" + nl
+            + "<|im_start|>assistant" + nl + "<think>{{ '\\n\\n' }}</think>{{ '\\n\\n' }}" + prompt["prefill"]
+        )
+
+    def set_gguf_parameters(self):
+        super().set_gguf_parameters()
+        self.gguf_writer.add_decision_type(gguf.DecisionType.H2O_LIGHTNING)
+        # the answer follows "Answer:", so the token of a label has a leading space
+        cfg = self._serve_config
+        self.gguf_writer.add_decision_labels([" " + label for label in cfg["labels"][:cfg.get("max_options", len(cfg["labels"]))]])
+        for name in ("choice", "noul", "score"):
+            self.gguf_writer.add_decision_temperature(name, self._serve_config["temperature"][name])
+        # a request with images has this temperature for all question types
+        self.gguf_writer.add_decision_temperature("image", self._serve_config["image"]["temperature"])
+
+

+@ModelBase.register("Lfm3ForCausalLM", "Lfm3VlForConditionalGeneration", "Lfm3OmniForConditionalGeneration")
+@ModelBase.example("LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B", "LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B-Base")
+class LFM3Model(TextModel):
+    model_arch = gguf.MODEL_ARCH.LFM3
+
+    # LFM3-Audio/Omni: encoder, projector and audio-output heads live next to the text model
+    _media_prefixes = ("encoder.", "mlp.", "codebook_embedding.", "depth_embeddings.", "depth_linear.", "depthformer.",
+                       "mask_embedding", "model.codebook_embedding.", "model.depth_decoder.")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def filter_tensors(cls, item: tuple[str, Callable[[], Tensor]]) -> tuple[str, Callable[[], Tensor]] | None:
+        name, gen = item
+
+        if name.startswith(cls._media_prefixes):
+            return None
+
+        name = name.removeprefix("lfm.")
+
+        return super().filter_tensors((name, gen))
+
+    # LFM3-Audio live ASR prompt of the model card, the audio follows in the assistant turn
+    _asr_template = (
+        "{{- bos_token -}}"
+        "{{- '<|im_start|>system\\nPerform live ASR.<|im_end|>\\n' -}}"
+        "{%- if add_generation_prompt -%}{{- '<|im_start|>assistant\\n' -}}{%- endif -%}"
+    )
+
+    # TTS prompt of the model card: a language code is looked up, anything else is taken as the language name
+    _tts_langs = {
+        "ar": "Arabic", "da": "Danish", "de": "German", "el": "Greek", "en": "American English", "en-us": "American English",
+        "en-gb": "British English", "fi": "Finnish", "fr": "French", "he": "Hebrew", "it": "Italian", "ja": "Japanese",
+        "ko": "Korean", "nl": "Dutch", "pl": "Polish", "pt": "Portuguese", "es": "Spanish", "sv": "Swedish", "tr": "Turkish",
+        "zh": "Chinese",
+    }
+
+    # "language" and "voice" are optional, the text to speak is the first message
+    def _tts_template(self, think: bool) -> str:
+        return (
+            "{%- set names = " + json.dumps(self._tts_langs) + " -%}"
+            "{%- set code = (language | lower) if language is defined and language else 'en' -%}"
+            "{%- set lang = names[code] if code in names else language -%}"
+            "{%- set v = (voice | lower) if voice is defined and voice and (voice | lower) in ['female', 'male'] else 'female' -%}"
+            "{{- bos_token -}}"
+            "{{- '<|im_start|>system\\nPerform TTS in ' + lang + ' using a ' + v + ' voice.<|im_end|>\\n' -}}"
+            "{{- '<|im_start|>user\\n' + messages[0]['content'] + '<|im_end|>\\n' -}}"
+            "{{- '<|im_start|>assistant\\n" + ("<think></think>" if think else "") + "<|audio_start|>' -}}"
+        )
+
+    def set_vocab(self):
+        super().set_vocab()
+        # hparams hold the merged text config, the checkpoint's own model_type is in config.json
+        with open(self.dir_model / "config.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            model_type = json.load(f).get("model_type")
+        is_audio = model_type == "lfm3_audio"
+        is_omni  = model_type == "lfm3_omni"
+        templates = []
+        if is_audio:
+            templates.append({"name": "asr", "template": self._asr_template})
+        if is_audio or is_omni:
+            # LFM3-Omni opens every assistant turn with an empty think block
+            templates.append({"name": "tts", "template": self._tts_template(think=is_omni)})
+        if templates:
+            self.gguf_writer.add_chat_template(templates)
+
+    def set_gguf_parameters(self):
+        layer_types = self.hparams["layer_types"]
+        n_kv_heads = self.hparams["num_key_value_heads"]
+
+        # set num_key_value_heads only for attention layers
+        self.hparams["num_key_value_heads"] = [
+            n_kv_heads if lt != "conv" else 0
+            for lt in layer_types
+        ]
+
+        super().set_gguf_parameters()
+
+        self.gguf_writer.add_rope_dimension_count(self.hparams["head_dim"])
+
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sliding_window_pattern([lt == "sliding_attention" for lt in layer_types])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sliding_window(self.hparams["sliding_window"])
+
+        self.gguf_writer.add_shortconv_l_cache(self.hparams["conv_L_cache"])
+
+    def generate_extra_tensors(self) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        # Partial RoPE is represented by masking trailing frequency pairs.
+        # rope_parameters is keyed by layer type; only full_attention layers use partial RoPE.
+        rope_parameters = self.hparams["rope_parameters"]["full_attention"]
+        partial = rope_parameters.get("partial_rotary_factor", 1.0)
+        head_dim = self.hparams["head_dim"]
+        rope_angles = int(partial * head_dim) // 2
+        n_pairs = head_dim // 2
+        assert 0 < rope_angles <= n_pairs
+        values = [1.0] * rope_angles + [1e30] * (n_pairs - rope_angles)
+        rope_freqs = torch.tensor(values, dtype=torch.float32)
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.ROPE_FREQS), rope_freqs)
+
+    def modify_tensors(self, data_torch: Tensor, name: str, bid: int | None) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        # conv op requires 2d tensor
+        if "conv.conv" in name:
+            data_torch = data_torch.squeeze(1)
+
+        yield from super().modify_tensors(data_torch, name, bid)

+
+# d1 on LFM3-VL / LFM3-Omni: the stock weights, the d1 prompt read at its last token
+_D1_TYPES = {"lfm3_vl": gguf.DecisionType.LFM3_D1, "lfm3_omni": gguf.DecisionType.LFM3_D1_OMNI}

+
+def _is_lfm3_d1_checkpoint(dir_model: Path) -> bool:
+    if not (dir_model / "config.json").is_file():
+        return False
+    with open(dir_model / "config.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        config = json.load(f)
+    return config.get("architectures") == ["D1Model"] and config.get("model_type") in _D1_TYPES

+@ModelBase.register_hparams_loader(_is_lfm3_d1_checkpoint)
+def _load_lfm3_d1_hparams(dir_model: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    logger.info("gguf: detected LFM3 d1 checkpoint")
+    hparams = ModelBase.load_hparams(dir_model, False, guess=False)
+    hparams["d1_family"] = hparams["model_type"]
+    # the mmproj is the base model's, the text model writes the decision
+    hparams["architectures"] = ["Lfm3VlForConditionalGeneration" if hparams["model_type"] == "lfm3_vl" else "Lfm3OmniForConditionalGeneration"]
+    hparams["text_config"]["architectures"] = ["Lfm3D1Model"]

+    def set_vocab(self):

+                raise ValueError(f"unsupported d1 checkpoint: {key} = {self.hparams.get(key)!r}, expected {value!r}")
+
+        # a lone question reads the whole prompt both ways on the full attention layers
+        self.gguf_writer.add_causal_attention(False)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_decision_type(_D1_TYPES[self.hparams["d1_family"]])
+
+        # the option answers share one temperature
+        with open(self.dir_model / "calibration.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            calibration = json.load(f)
+        if calibration.get("temperatures"):
+            raise ValueError("unsupported d1 calibration: per-bucket temperatures")
+        for name in ("noul", "choice", "score"):
+            self.gguf_writer.add_decision_temperature(name, calibration["default"])

+class LFM3VLVisionMixin(MmprojModel):
+    """LFM3-VL vision tower and projector, shared with LFM3-Omni."""
+
+    def _set_lfm3vl_gguf_parameters(self):
+        assert self.hparams_vision is not None
+        # clip.cpp hardcodes the GELU projector and its input norm eps
+        if (self.global_config["projector_hidden_act"] != "gelu" or not self.global_config["projector_bias"]
+                or self.global_config["projector_layer_norm_eps"] != 1e-6):
+            raise ValueError("unsupported projector_hidden_act / projector_bias / projector_layer_norm_eps")
+        # clip.cpp hardcodes the vision rope base, the RGB patchifier and the 3x3 spatial conv
+        if (self.hparams_vision["rope_parameters"]["rope_theta"] != 1e6 or self.hparams_vision["in_channels"] != 3
+                or self.hparams_vision["conv_kernel_size"] != 3):
+            raise ValueError("unsupported vision rope_theta / in_channels / conv_kernel_size")
+        self.gguf_writer.add_clip_vision_projector_type(gguf.VisionProjectorType.LFM3VL)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_vision_head_count_kv(self.hparams_vision["num_key_value_heads"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_vision_spatial_merge_size(self.global_config["downsample_factor"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_vision_attention_layernorm_eps(self.hparams_vision["norm_eps"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_vision_use_silu(True)
+        size = self.preprocessor_config["size"]
+        self.gguf_writer.add_vision_min_pixels(size["shortest_edge"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_vision_max_pixels(size["longest_edge"])
+        # PIL resample enum, the torchvision backend has no lanczos
+        resample = self.preprocessor_config["resample"]
+        resize_algo = {2: "bilinear", 3: "bicubic"}.get(resample)
+        if resize_algo is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"unsupported resample: {resample}")
+        self.gguf_writer.add_vision_image_resize_algo(resize_algo)
+        self._check_video_config()
+
+    # mtmd_get_video_ts_style and the lfm3vl video frame sizing hardcode these, conversion fails on a mismatch
+    _video = {"fps": 2.0, "min_frames": 4, "temporal_patch_size": 2, "size": {"shortest_edge": 4096, "longest_edge": 25165824}}
+    _video_max_frames = 768
+
+    def _check_video_config(self):
+        import json
+        video = self.preprocessor_config.get("video_processor")
+        path = self.dir_model / "video_preprocessor_config.json"
+        if video is None and path.is_file():
+            with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                video = json.load(f)
+        if video is None:
+            return
+        for k, v in {**self._video, "max_frames": self._video_max_frames}.items():
+            if video.get(k) != v:
+                raise ValueError(f"unsupported video {k}={video.get(k)!r}, expected {v!r}")
+
+    def tensor_force_quant(self, name, new_name, bid, n_dims):
+        if "patch_embd" in new_name:
+            return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F16
+        if "conv2d_spatial" in new_name:
+            # CUDA CONV_2D_DW requires an f32 kernel; the tensor is tiny
+            return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F32
+        return super().tensor_force_quant(name, new_name, bid, n_dims)
+
+    def _lfm3vl_tensors(self, data_torch: Tensor, name: str, bid: int | None) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        if name == "model.vision_tower.patchifier.weight":
+            # qwen2vl-style layout [channel, temporal, ph, pw], one conv kernel per temporal slice
+            assert self.hparams_vision is not None
+            t = self.hparams_vision["temporal_patch_size"]
+            p = self.hparams_vision["patch_size"]
+            n_embd = data_torch.shape[0]
+            w = data_torch.view(n_embd, 3, t, p, p)
+            yield ("v.patch_embd.weight", w[:, :, 0].contiguous())
+            if t == 2:
+                yield ("v.patch_embd.weight.1", w[:, :, 1].contiguous())
+            else:
+                assert t == 1, f"unsupported vision_temporal_patch_size {t}"
+            return
+        if name == "model.vision_tower.embedding_norm.weight":
+            yield ("v.embedding_norm.weight", data_torch)
+            return
+        if "conv.in_proj.weight" in name:
+            yield (f"v.blk.{bid}.conv2d_in_proj.weight", data_torch)
+            return
+        if "conv.spatial_conv.weight" in name:
+            yield (f"v.blk.{bid}.conv2d_spatial.weight", data_torch)
+            return
+        if "conv.out_proj.weight" in name:
+            yield (f"v.blk.{bid}.conv2d_out_proj.weight", data_torch)
+            return
+
+        # projector: input LayerNorm -> linear_1 -> GELU -> linear_2
+        if name.startswith("model.multi_modal_projector."):
+            layer, suffix = name.removeprefix("model.multi_modal_projector.").split(".")
+            yield ({"layer_norm": "mm.input_norm", "linear_1": "mm.0", "linear_2": "mm.2"}[layer] + "." + suffix, data_torch)
+            return
+
+        yield (self.map_tensor_name(name), data_torch)
+

+        if new_name.startswith("a.conv1d.") or "conv_dw" in new_name or new_name.startswith("a.gen.wav.quant."):
+            return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F32

+
+    def generate_extra_tensors(self) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        if self._audio_output:
+            yield from self._codec_tensors()
+
+    def _codec_tensors(self) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        import json
+        from safetensors.torch import load_file
+
+        T = gguf.MODEL_TENSOR
+        codec_dir = self.dir_model / "audio_tokenizer"
+        with open(codec_dir / "config.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            cfg = json.load(f)
+        for k, v in self._codec.items():
+            if cfg.get(k) != v:
+                raise ValueError(f"unsupported audio_tokenizer {k}={cfg.get(k)!r}, expected {v!r}")
+        if math.prod(cfg["fsq_levels"]) != self._audio_vocab - 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"audio_vocab_size {self._audio_vocab} does not match the codec, expected codebook size + 1")
+
+        state_dict = load_file(codec_dir / "model.safetensors")
+
+        # FSQ code table: index -> the len(levels) quantized values, see FiniteScalarQuantization._indices_to_codes
+        levels = torch.tensor(cfg["fsq_levels"], dtype=torch.int64)
+        basis = torch.cumprod(torch.cat([torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.int64), levels[:-1]]), dim=0)
+        half = levels // 2
+        idx = torch.arange(int(levels.prod()), dtype=torch.int64)[:, None]
+        codes = ((idx // basis) % levels - half) / half
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_QUANT_FIRST_CB), codes.to(torch.float32))
+
+        # one projection over the concatenated code vectors of all codebooks, under quantizer.fsq. in newer exports
+        quantizer = "quantizer.fsq." if "quantizer.fsq.project_out.weight" in state_dict else "quantizer."
+        for suffix in ("weight", "bias"):
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_QUANT_FIRST_OUT, suffix=f".{suffix}"), state_dict[f"{quantizer}project_out.{suffix}"])
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_IN_PROJ, suffix=f".{suffix}"), state_dict[f"from_quantizer.{suffix}"])
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_OUT_PROJ, suffix=f".{suffix}"), state_dict[f"decoder.lin.{suffix}"])
+        yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_WAV_TFM_OUTPUT_NORM), state_dict["decoder.lfm.embedding_norm.weight"])
+
+        for name, data_torch in state_dict.items():
+            if not name.startswith("decoder.lfm.layers."):
+                continue
+            bid_str, key = name.removeprefix("decoder.lfm.layers.").rsplit(".weight", 1)[0].split(".", 1)
+            if key == "conv.conv":
+                data_torch = data_torch.squeeze(1)
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(self._codec_layer_map[key], int(bid_str)), data_torch)
+
+    def modify_tensors(self, data_torch: Tensor, name: str, bid: int | None) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        if name.startswith("a.gen.wav."):
+            yield (name, data_torch)
+            return
+
+        if name.startswith(("depthformer.", "depth_", "codebook_embedding.", "mask_embedding")):
+            if self._audio_output:
+                yield from self._depthformer_tensor(data_torch, name, bid)
+            return
+
+        if not name.startswith(("encoder.", "mlp.")):
+            return
+
+        if name.startswith("encoder.downsample."):
+            layer, suffix = name.removeprefix("encoder.downsample.").split(".")
+            if layer == "lin_out":
+                if suffix == "weight":
+                    data_torch = data_torch.squeeze(-1)
+                yield (self.format_tensor_name(gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.A_ENC_OUT, suffix=f".{suffix}"), data_torch)
+                return
+            if suffix == "bias":
+                data_torch = data_torch[:, None, None]
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.A_ENC_CONV1D, self._downsample_idx[layer], f".{suffix}"), data_torch)
+            return
+
+        # conv op requires 2d tensor
+        if name.endswith("conv.conv.weight"):
+            data_torch = data_torch.squeeze(1)
+
+        yield (self.map_tensor_name(name), data_torch)
+
+    def _depthformer_tensor(self, data_torch: Tensor, name: str, bid: int | None) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        T = gguf.MODEL_TENSOR
+
+        if name.startswith("depthformer.model.layers."):
+            key = name.removeprefix("depthformer.model.layers.").split(".", 1)[1].rsplit(".weight", 1)[0]
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(self._depth_layer_map[key], bid), data_torch)
+            return
+        if name == "depthformer.model.embedding_norm.weight":
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_OUTPUT_NORM), data_torch)
+            return
+        if name.startswith("depth_linear."):
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_PROJ_IN, suffix="." + name.rsplit(".", 1)[1]), data_torch)
+            return
+        if name == "mask_embedding":
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_MASK_EMBD, suffix=""), data_torch)
+            return
+        if name == "codebook_embedding.weight":
+            assert data_torch.shape[0] == self._n_codebooks * self._audio_vocab
+            yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_OUT_EMBD), data_torch)
+            return
+
+        # per-codebook heads: the embedding table is tied to to_logits, merge the 12 tables into one tensor
+        assert name.startswith("depth_embeddings.")
+        idx = int(name.split(".")[1])
+        key = name.split(".", 2)[2]
+        if key == "embedding.weight":
+            self._depth_embd[idx] = data_torch
+            if len(self._depth_embd) == self._n_codebooks:
+                yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_EMBD), torch.stack([self._depth_embd[i] for i in range(self._n_codebooks)], dim=0))
+        elif key == "embedding_norm.weight":
+            self._depth_norm[idx] = data_torch
+            if len(self._depth_norm) == self._n_codebooks:
+                yield (self.format_tensor_name(T.A_GEN_CODE_HEAD_NORM), torch.stack([self._depth_norm[i] for i in range(self._n_codebooks)], dim=0))
+        elif key == "to_logits.weight":
+            if not torch.equal(data_torch, self._depth_embd[idx]):
+                raise ValueError(f"depth_embeddings.{idx} is not tied")
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unexpected tensor {name}")
+

+@ModelBase.register("LimiteForCausalLM")
+@ModelBase.example("paradigma-inc/limite-1b-violetto")
+class LimiteModel(TextModel):
+    model_arch = gguf.MODEL_ARCH.LIMITE
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        hp = self.hparams
+
+        expected = {
+            "pos_mode": "rope",
+            "qk_norm": "rms_pre_rope",
+            "rope_style": "interleaved_pairs_odd_lane_sign_flip",
+            "rope_per_layer": False,
+            "rms_norm_has_weight": False,
+            "rms_norm_eps_mode": "torch_finfo_default",
+            "mlp_type": "swiglu",
+            "attn_gate_applied": "per_head_before_o_proj",
+            "ve_head_slice": "first_num_key_value_heads",
+            "ve_applied_before_qk_norm": True,
+            "global_nope": True,
+            "global_window": -1,
+            "mudd_r_site": "resid",
+            "tie_word_embeddings": True,
+            "final_softcap": 0.0,
+        }
+        for key, value in expected.items():
+            if hp.get(key) != value:
+                raise NotImplementedError(f"Limite: unsupported {key}={hp.get(key)!r}, expected {value!r}")
+        if hp["softcap_logits"]["kind"] != "sigmoid":
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"Limite: unsupported softcap_logits kind {hp['softcap_logits']['kind']!r}")
+
+        self.n_head    = hp["num_attention_heads"]
+        self.n_head_kv = hp["num_key_value_heads"]
+        self.head_dim  = hp["head_dim"]
+        self.n_pairs   = hp["rope_n_pairs"]
+
+        self.mudd_taps: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
+        if hp.get("mudd"):
+            if not hp.get("mudd_mlp"):
+                raise NotImplementedError("Limite: mudd without mudd_mlp is not supported")
+            self.mudd_taps = {int(il): [int(t) for t in taps] for il, taps in hp["mudd_tap_idx"].items()}
+            assert all(len(taps) == hp["mudd_taps"] for taps in self.mudd_taps.values())
+
+    def set_vocab(self):
+        self._set_vocab_gpt2()
+
+    def set_gguf_parameters(self):
+        super().set_gguf_parameters()
+        hp = self.hparams
+
+        self.gguf_writer.add_key_length(self.head_dim)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_value_length(self.head_dim)
+
+        # torch rms_norm with eps=None uses the fp32 epsilon, even for bf16 inputs
+        self.gguf_writer.add_layer_norm_rms_eps(torch.finfo(torch.float32).eps)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_attention_scale(hp["attention_softmax_scale"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_xsa_eps(hp["xsa_normalize_eps"] if hp.get("xsa") else 0.0)
+
+        # HF freq_i = base^(-i/(n_pairs-1)), ggml uses freq_base^(-i/n_pairs)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_rope_dimension_count(2 * self.n_pairs)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_rope_freq_base(hp["rope_base_local"] ** (self.n_pairs / (self.n_pairs - 1)))
+
+        # HF keeps keys k >= q - window, so a window of W spans W + 1 tokens
+        global_layers = set(hp["global_layers"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sliding_window(hp["sliding_window"] + 1)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sliding_window_pattern([il not in global_layers for il in range(self.block_count)])
+
+        cap = hp["softcap_logits"]
+        self.gguf_writer.add_final_logit_sigmoid_capping(cap["a"], cap["b"], cap["c"])
+
+        if self.mudd_taps:
+            n_taps = hp["mudd_taps"]
+            tap_indices = [-1] * (self.block_count * n_taps)
+            for il, taps in self.mudd_taps.items():
+                tap_indices[il * n_taps:(il + 1) * n_taps] = taps
+            self.gguf_writer.add_mudd_feed_forward_length(hp["mudd_inter"])
+            self.gguf_writer.add_mudd_tap_count(n_taps)
+            self.gguf_writer.add_mudd_tap_indices(tap_indices)
+
+    def tensor_force_quant(self, name, new_name, bid, n_dims):
+        # tiny mixing weights, kept at full precision as in the reference
+        # the mudd tensors come from a global source tensor, so take the block id from the new name
+        if new_name.startswith("blk."):
+            bid = int(new_name.split(".")[1])
+        for key in (gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.ATTN_GATE, gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.ATTN_VE_GATE, gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.MUDD_DOWN, gguf.MODEL_TENSOR.MUDD_UP):
+            if self.match_model_tensor_name(new_name, key, bid):
+                return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F32
+        return super().tensor_force_quant(name, new_name, bid, n_dims)
+
+    def _swap_rope_pairs(self, w: Tensor, n_head: int) -> Tensor:
+        # HF rotates each pair by -theta; swapping the pair lanes gives the ggml +theta rotation.
+        # q and k are both swapped, so the attention scores do not change.
+        idx = torch.arange(self.head_dim)
+        idx[:2 * self.n_pairs] = idx[:2 * self.n_pairs].view(-1, 2).flip(-1).reshape(-1)
+        w = w.reshape(n_head, self.head_dim, -1)
+        return w[:, idx, :].reshape(n_head * self.head_dim, -1)
+
+    def _pad_cols(self, w: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        # gates read only the first channels of the input, pad them to n_embd
+        return torch.nn.functional.pad(w, (0, self.hparams["hidden_size"] - w.shape[-1]))
+
+    def modify_tensors(self, data_torch: Tensor, name: str, bid: int | None) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        hp = self.hparams
+        T = gguf.MODEL_TENSOR
+
+        def load(n: str) -> Tensor:
+            return self.model_tensors[n]().float()
+
+        if name == "model.value_embeds.weight":
+            ve = data_torch.reshape(data_torch.shape[0], -1, hp["ve_dim"])[:, :self.n_head_kv]
+            ve = torch.nn.functional.pad(ve, (0, self.head_dim - hp["ve_dim"]))
+            yield self.format_tensor_name(T.VALUE_EMBD), ve.reshape(ve.shape[0], -1) * hp["ve_gate_scale"]
+            return
+
+        if name == "model.mudd.dense1":
+            for il in self.mudd_taps:
+                yield self.format_tensor_name(T.MUDD_DOWN, il), data_torch
+            return
+        if name == "model.mudd.dense2":
+            # rows [0, n) mix the attention input, rows [n, 2n) mix the residual
+            dense2_mlp = load("model.mudd.dense2_mlp")
+            bias       = load("model.mudd.bias")
+            bias_mlp   = load("model.mudd.bias_mlp")
+            for il, taps in self.mudd_taps.items():
+                n = len(taps)
+                w = torch.cat([data_torch[il, :n], dense2_mlp[il, :n]], 0)
+                b = torch.cat([bias[il, :n], bias_mlp[il, :n]], 0)
+                yield self.format_tensor_name(T.MUDD_UP, il), w
+                yield self.format_tensor_name(T.MUDD_UP, il, ".bias"), b
+            return
+        if name.startswith("model.mudd."):
+            return
+
+        if bid is None:
+            yield from super().modify_tensors(data_torch, name, bid)
+            return
+
+        prefix = f"model.layers.{bid}."
+        name = name.removeprefix(prefix)
+
+        if name in ("self_attn.q_proj.weight", "self_attn.k_proj.weight", "self_attn.v_proj.weight"):
+            data_torch = data_torch * load(prefix + "self_attn.qkv_scale")
+            if name == "self_attn.q_proj.weight":
+                data_torch = self._swap_rope_pairs(data_torch, self.n_head)
+            elif name == "self_attn.k_proj.weight":
+                data_torch = self._swap_rope_pairs(data_torch, self.n_head_kv)
+        elif name == "self_attn.o_proj.weight":
+            data_torch = data_torch * load(prefix + "self_attn.o_scale") * load(prefix + "post_lambda_attn") * hp["attn_gate_scale"]
+        elif name == "mlp.down_proj.weight":
+            data_torch = data_torch * load(prefix + "post_lambda_mlp")
+        elif name == "self_attn.attn_gate":
+            yield self.format_tensor_name(T.ATTN_GATE, bid), self._pad_cols(data_torch)
+            return
+        elif name == "self_attn.ve_gate":
+            yield self.format_tensor_name(T.ATTN_VE_GATE, bid), self._pad_cols(data_torch[:self.n_head_kv])
+            return
+        elif name == "self_attn.xsa_alpha":
+            if hp.get("xsa") and bid in hp["xsa_layers"]:
+                yield self.format_tensor_name(T.ATTN_XSA_ALPHA, bid), torch.tanh(data_torch)
+            return
+        elif name == "resid_lambda_attn":
+            yield self.format_tensor_name(T.ATTN_RESID_SCALE, bid), data_torch.reshape(1)
+            return
+        elif name == "resid_lambda_mlp":
+            yield self.format_tensor_name(T.FFN_RESID_SCALE, bid), data_torch.reshape(1)
+            return
+        elif name in ("self_attn.qkv_scale", "self_attn.o_scale", "post_lambda_attn", "post_lambda_mlp"):
+            # folded into the projections above
+            return
+
+        yield from super().modify_tensors(data_torch, prefix + name, bid)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math

+@ModelBase.register("RicursiveForCausalLM")

+    model_arch = gguf.MODEL_ARCH.RICURSIVE
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        hparams = self.hparams
+
+        if (act := hparams.get("hidden_act", "silu")) != "silu":
+            raise ValueError(f"Ricursive: unsupported hidden_act {act!r}")
+
+        # RicursiveConfig derives the layer pattern from layer_types alone, by default full attention iff i % 5 == 4
+        if (layer_types := hparams.get("layer_types")) is None:
+            layer_types = ["full_attention" if i % 5 == 4 else "sliding_attention" for i in range(self.block_count)]
+        if len(layer_types) != self.block_count:
+            raise ValueError(f"Ricursive: layer_types has {len(layer_types)} entries, expected {self.block_count}")
+        if unknown := set(layer_types) - {"sliding_attention", "full_attention"}:
+            raise ValueError(f"Ricursive: unsupported layer_types {sorted(unknown)}")
+        self.is_swa = [t == "sliding_attention" for t in layer_types]
+        # only sliding layers use RoPE, an all-full-attention model would have no positional encoding
+        if not any(self.is_swa):
+            raise ValueError("Ricursive: layer_types has no sliding_attention layer, all-full-attention models are not supported")
+        # RicursiveConfig pops a stored hybrid_layer_pattern and recomputes it from layer_types
+        if (pattern := hparams.get("hybrid_layer_pattern")) is not None and list(pattern) != [int(swa) for swa in self.is_swa]:
+            logger.warning("Ricursive: hybrid_layer_pattern does not match layer_types, ignoring it")
+
+        if not hparams.get("gate_full_precision", True):
+            logger.warning("Ricursive: gate_full_precision is false, llama.cpp computes the attention gate in f32")
+
+        # RicursiveConfig defaults; the reference ignores the tensors of a disabled feature
+        self.use_valres = hparams.get("use_valres", False)
+        self.use_gate = hparams.get("use_gated_attention", True)
+        names = list(self.model_tensors)
+        if bias := [name for name in names if name.endswith("bias")]:
+            raise ValueError(f"Ricursive: bias tensors are not supported, found {bias[0]!r}")
+        for enabled, suffix in ((self.use_valres, ".self_attn.value_res_lambda"), (self.use_gate, ".self_attn.g_proj.weight")):
+            if enabled and sum(name.endswith(suffix) for name in names) != self.block_count:
+                raise ValueError(f"Ricursive: expected one {suffix!r} tensor per layer")
+
+    def set_vocab(self):
+        self._set_vocab_gpt2()
+        # eos_token_id is [<|im_end|>, <|endoftext|>]: register the turn end as EOT so generation stops on it
+        eos = self.hparams.get("eos_token_id")
+        if isinstance(eos, list):
+            extra = [e for e in eos if e != self.hparams.get("bos_token_id")]
+            if extra:
+                self.gguf_writer.add_eot_token_id(extra[0])
+                logger.info(f"gguf: eot_token_id = {extra[0]}")
+
+    def set_gguf_parameters(self):
+        super().set_gguf_parameters()
+        hparams = self.hparams
+        self.gguf_writer.add_vocab_size(hparams["vocab_size"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_rope_dimension_count(hparams["head_dim"])
+
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sliding_window(hparams["sliding_window"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_sliding_window_pattern(self.is_swa)
+        # sliding layers use RoPE, full attention layers use no positional encoding
+        self.gguf_writer.add_rope_pattern(self.is_swa)
+
+        if (embed_scale := hparams.get("embed_scale")) is not None:
+            if embed_scale == 0:
+                raise ValueError(f"Ricursive: unsupported embed_scale {embed_scale!r}")
+            self.gguf_writer.add_embedding_scale(float(embed_scale))
+        # absent and 0 both mean no clamp (the reference tests `if clamp_threshold:`)
+        if (clamp := hparams.get("ffn_clamp_threshold")) is not None:
+            if clamp < 0 or not math.isfinite(clamp):
+                raise ValueError(f"Ricursive: unsupported ffn_clamp_threshold {clamp!r}")
+            self.gguf_writer.add_swiglu_clamp([float(clamp)] * self.block_count)
+
+    def modify_tensors(self, data_torch: Tensor, name: str, bid: int | None) -> Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]:
+        # value_res_lambda has no .weight suffix in the checkpoint
+        if name.endswith(".value_res_lambda"):
+            if not self.use_valres:
+                return
+            name += ".weight"
+        elif name.endswith(".g_proj.weight") and not self.use_gate:
+            return
+        yield from super().modify_tensors(data_torch, name, bid)

+        if not name.startswith("language_model.") or "_mot_gen" in name:
+            return None
+        return super().filter_tensors(item)
+
+    def set_gguf_parameters(self):
+        if int(self.hparams.get("num_experts") or 0) > 1:
+            raise ValueError("SenseNova U1 conversion currently supports the dense understanding branch")
+        if self.rope_parameters.get("rope_type", "default") not in ("default", None):
+            raise ValueError("SenseNova U1 scaled RoPE is not supported")
+        if self.hparams.get("attention_bias", False):
+            raise ValueError("SenseNova U1 attention bias is not supported")
+        if self.hparams.get("use_sliding_window", False):
+            raise ValueError("SenseNova U1 sliding attention is not supported")
+        super().set_gguf_parameters()
+        self.gguf_writer.add_rope_freq_base_spatial(self.hparams["rope_theta_hw"])

+        for name, gen in self.model_tensors.items():
+            if name.endswith((".q_norm_hw.weight", ".k_norm_hw.weight")):
+                continue
+            data = gen()
+            if name.endswith((".q_norm.weight", ".k_norm.weight")):
+                spatial = self.model_tensors[name.replace("_norm.weight", "_norm_hw.weight")]()
+                # Keep one weight vector; the graph normalizes its two halves independently.
+                data = torch.cat((data, spatial), dim=0)
+            yield name, data

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from .base import ModelBase, MmprojModel, gguf, logger
+from .qwen import Qwen3Model
+
+
+def _is_soprano_checkpoint(dir_model: Path) -> bool:
+    if not (dir_model / "decoder.pth").is_file() or not (dir_model / "config.json").is_file():
+        return False
+    with open(dir_model / "config.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        config = json.load(f)
+    if config.get("model_type") != "qwen3" or config.get("bos_token_id") != 3 or config.get("eos_token_id") != 3:
+        return False
+    if not (dir_model / "tokenizer.json").is_file():
+        return False
+    with open(dir_model / "tokenizer.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        added = {t["id"]: t["content"] for t in json.load(f).get("added_tokens", [])}
+    return [added.get(i) for i in range(4)] == ["[UNK]", "[TEXT]", "[START]", "[STOP]"]
+
+
+@ModelBase.register_hparams_loader(_is_soprano_checkpoint)
+def _load_soprano_hparams(dir_model: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    logger.info("gguf: detected Soprano checkpoint")
+    hparams = ModelBase.load_hparams(dir_model, False, guess=False)
+    # the text model stays Qwen3, the mmproj holds the decoder
+    hparams["text_config"] = {"architectures": ["SopranoTextModel"]}
+    hparams["architectures"] = ["SopranoModel"]
+    return hparams
+
+
+@ModelBase.register("SopranoTextModel")
+class SopranoTextModel(Qwen3Model):
+    model_arch = gguf.MODEL_ARCH.QWEN3
+
+    def get_vocab_base_pre(self, tokenizer) -> str:
+        return "soprano"
+
+    def set_vocab(self):
+        super().set_vocab()
+        self.gguf_writer.add_unk_token_id(0)
+
+
+@ModelBase.register("SopranoModel")
+@ModelBase.example("ekwek/Soprano-80M", "ekwek/Soprano-1.1-80M")
+class SopranoModel(MmprojModel):
+    has_vision_encoder = False
+    has_audio_encoder = False
+
+    def _load_decoder(self) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        state = torch.load(self.dir_model / "decoder.pth", map_location="cpu", mmap=True, weights_only=True)
+        return state.get("state_dict", state)
+
+    def get_audio_config(self):
+        state = self._load_decoder()
+        n_embd, n_inp, _ = state["decoder.embed.weight"].shape
+        n_ff = state["decoder.convnext.0.pwconv1.weight"].shape[0]
+        n_layer = sum(1 for name in state if name.endswith(".pwconv1.weight"))
+        if n_inp != self.n_embd_text:
+            raise ValueError(f"Soprano decoder input dim {n_inp} does not match the backbone dim {self.n_embd_text}")
+        return {"num_hidden_layers": n_layer, "hidden_size": n_embd, "intermediate_size": n_ff}
+
+    def set_gguf_parameters(self):
+        self.gguf_writer.add_file_type(self.ftype)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_clip_has_gen_audio_encoder(True)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_clip_gen_audio_projector_type(gguf.VisionProjectorType.SOPRANO)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_gen_audio_projection_dim(self.n_embd_text)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_gen_audio_embedding_length(self.hparams["hidden_size"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_gen_audio_feed_forward_length(self.hparams["intermediate_size"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_gen_audio_block_count(self.hparams["num_hidden_layers"])
+        self.gguf_writer.add_gen_audio_head_count(1)
+        self.gguf_writer.add_gen_audio_attention_layernorm_eps(1e-6)
+
+    def get_tensors(self):
+        yield from self._load_decoder().items()
+
+    def tensor_force_quant(self, name, new_name, bid, n_dims):
+        if "dwconv.weight" in new_name or (name == "decoder.embed.weight" and n_dims == 3):
+            return gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.F16
+        return super().tensor_force_quant(name, new_name, bid, n_dims)
+
+    def modify_tensors(self, data_torch, name, bid):
+        if name == "head.istft.window":
+            # the ISTFT in mtmd builds its own window
+            if not torch.equal(data_torch.float(), torch.hann_window(data_torch.shape[0])):
+                raise ValueError("Soprano requires a periodic Hann window")
+            return
+        if name == "decoder.embed.weight" and data_torch.shape[-1] == 1:
+            data_torch = data_torch.squeeze(-1)
+
+        T = gguf.MODEL_TENSOR
+        if name.startswith("decoder.convnext."):
+            _, _, blk, key, *suffix = name.split(".")
+            block_map = {
+                "dwconv":  T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_DWCONV,
+                "norm":    T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_NORM,
+                "pwconv1": T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_PW1,
+                "pwconv2": T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_PW2,
+                "gamma":   T.A_GEN_WAV_UP_GAMMA,
+            }
+            yield self.format_tensor_name(block_map[key], int(blk), suffix="".join("." + s for s in suffix)), data_torch
+            return
+
+        tensor_map = {
+            "decoder.embed":            T.A_GEN_WAV_INPUT,
+            "decoder.norm":             T.A_GEN_WAV_NORM,
+            "decoder.final_layer_norm": T.A_GEN_WAV_OUTPUT_NORM,
+            "head.out":                 T.A_GEN_WAV_OUTPUT,
+        }
+        key, suffix = name.rsplit(".", 1)
+        yield self.format_tensor_name(tensor_map[key], suffix="." + suffix), data_torch

+
+import re
